---
title: "Green per person (Malta): does a log transformation suit it?"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    code_folding: show
---

Follows `mcda/MCDA_paper_results_spec.md`: p98 computed from the data, missing stays missing,
available weight rule (80%), quintiles within city, Spearman only. Reads the saved Malta score
(`data/malta/malta_mcda_processed_realloc_pre_gpp_log.rds`, the score before the log change); nothing is written back. Green per person is the
E2SFCA computed for this study (`green_m2_e2sfca_per_person_gauss`, spec 3.3).

Three normalisations of green per person are compared (1 = highest priority = least green):

- **current**: min-max capped at p98, as in the score;
- **log**: log(x + c), min-max capped at the p98 of the log values, c = smallest non zero value;
- **rank**: 1 - percentile rank.

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(e1071)   # skewness()

# The score as it was before the log change (2026-11-19); the main file now holds the log version
malta <- readRDS(here::here("data/malta/malta_mcda_processed_realloc_pre_gpp_log.rds"))
cat("Cells:", nrow(malta), "| distinct gid:", n_distinct(malta$gid), "\n")
stopifnot(nrow(malta) == 10657, n_distinct(malta$gid) == 10657)
```

# 0. Settings

Airport and port cells (not eligible, spec 1.3) are removed. Column names are those of
`Malta_MCDA_260702_realloc.Rmd`. Weights are not typed in: they are recovered from the saved score
(on complete cells the score is exactly sum(w_i * s_i)) and compared with the citizen weights.

```{r settings}
dat_sf <- malta %>% filter(!ua_not_eligible)
dat    <- st_drop_geometry(dat_sf)
cat("Eligible cells:", nrow(dat), "| not eligible removed:", sum(malta$ua_not_eligible), "\n")

gpp_col   <- "green_m2_e2sfca_per_person_gauss"   # m2 per person, raw, not normalised
norm_cols <- c(lst = "norm_lst", no2 = "norm_no2", traffic = "norm_traffic",
               green_time = "norm_green_time", blue = "norm_dist_bs",
               tree = "norm_tree", imd = "norm_imd", gpp = "norm_green_exp",
               noise = "norm_Lden", recreation = "norm_dist_rec")

cc  <- dat[complete.cases(dat[, c(norm_cols, "priority_citizen")]), ]
fit <- lm(reformulate(unname(norm_cols), "priority_citizen", intercept = FALSE), data = cc)
weights <- setNames(unname(coef(fit)), names(norm_cols))
cat("Max |residual| of the weight recovery:", signif(max(abs(resid(fit))), 2), "\n")
stopifnot(max(abs(resid(fit))) < 1e-9, abs(sum(weights) - 1) < 1e-9)
knitr::kable(tibble(criterion = names(weights), column = unname(norm_cols),
                    weight_pct = round(100 * weights, 1)))

x <- dat[[gpp_col]]
```

# 1. Shape in numbers

```{r shape}
nz <- x[!is.na(x) & x > 0]
desc <- tibble(
  n           = sum(!is.na(x)),
  missing     = sum(is.na(x)),
  zeros_pct   = 100 * mean(x == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  skew_raw    = skewness(x, na.rm = TRUE),
  median      = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
  p75         = quantile(x, .75, na.rm = TRUE),
  p98         = quantile(x, .98, na.rm = TRUE),
  max         = max(x, na.rm = TRUE),
  min_nonzero = min(nz)
)
knitr::kable(desc, digits = 3)
summary(x)

ggplot(tibble(x = x), aes(x)) + geom_histogram(bins = 60) +
  labs(x = "Green space per person (m²)", y = "Cells", title = "Raw scale") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Populated and unpopulated cells

Population is the study population (`pop_reallocated_nso`, spec 1.2), joined by gid.

```{r shape-populated}
pop_nso <- st_read(here::here("data/malta/Population_Malta_reallocated_nso.gpkg"), quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(gid = as.character(gid), pop_reallocated_nso)

plot_dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(gid = as.character(gid)) %>%
  left_join(pop_nso, by = "gid") %>%
  mutate(populated = if_else(pop_reallocated_nso > 0, "Populated", "Unpopulated"),
         x = .data[[gpp_col]])
stopifnot(nrow(plot_dat) == nrow(dat), !anyNA(plot_dat$pop_reallocated_nso))

plot_dat %>%
  group_by(populated) %>%
  summarise(cells = n(), n = sum(!is.na(x)), missing = sum(is.na(x)),
            zeros_pct = 100 * mean(x == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
            median = median(x, na.rm = TRUE), p98 = quantile(x, .98, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)

ggplot(filter(plot_dat, !is.na(x), x > 0), aes(x)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = ",", drop0trailing = TRUE)) +
  facet_wrap(~ populated, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Green space per person (m², log axis, zeros excluded)", y = "Cells") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# 2. Does the log fix the shape?

Populated cells, no offset.

```{r log-shape-populated}
pop    <- plot_dat$pop_reallocated_nso > 0   # same rows and order as dat (checked in section 1)
stopifnot(identical(as.character(plot_dat$gid), as.character(dat$gid)))
x_pop  <- x[pop & !is.na(x)]
lx_pop <- log10(x_pop[x_pop > 0])            # log only of non zero values

cat("Zeros among populated cells:", round(100 * mean(x_pop == 0), 1), "%\n")
cat("Skewness, populated non zero cells | log10:", round(skewness(lx_pop), 2),
    "| raw:", round(skewness(x_pop[x_pop > 0]), 2), "\n")

ggplot(tibble(lx = lx_pop), aes(lx)) + geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
  labs(x = "log10(m² per person), populated cells, zeros excluded", y = "Cells") +
  theme_minimal()
ggplot(tibble(lx = lx_pop), aes(sample = lx)) + stat_qq() + stat_qq_line() +
  labs(title = "QQ plot, populated non zero cells, log10") + theme_minimal()
```

# 3. Normalised scores under each method

```{r norm-versions}
minmax_cap <- function(v, upper) {
  v <- pmin(v, upper); lo <- min(v, na.rm = TRUE)
  (v - lo) / (upper - lo)
}

norm_versions <- function(x, c_off) {
  p98 <- quantile(x, .98, na.rm = TRUE)
  lx  <- log(x + c_off)
  tibble(
    current = 1 - minmax_cap(x, p98),
    log     = 1 - minmax_cap(lx, quantile(lx, .98, na.rm = TRUE)),
    rank    = 1 - percent_rank(x)
  )
}
c_main <- min(nz)                            # offset of the "log" version = smallest non zero value
nv <- norm_versions(x, c_main)

# check: "current" reproduces the score's norm_green_exp. The p98 is computed here on eligible
# cells, in the notebook on all cells, so small differences are possible; report them
cat("current vs saved norm_green_exp, max |diff|:",
    signif(max(abs(nv$current - dat$norm_green_exp), na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")

spread <- nv %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), list(
    above_0.9_pct = ~ 100 * mean(.x > 0.9, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr           = ~ IQR(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = c("version", ".value"),
                      names_pattern = "(.*)_(above_0.9_pct|iqr)")
knitr::kable(spread, digits = 3)

nv %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "version", values_to = "score") %>%
  ggplot(aes(score)) + geom_histogram(bins = 50) + facet_wrap(~version, ncol = 3) +
  labs(x = "Normalised green per person (1 = highest priority)", y = "Cells") + theme_minimal()
```

# 4 and 5. Effective weight and effect on the map

The effective weight of a criterion is its citizen weight times the standard deviation of its
normalised scores, as a share of the total: a criterion that barely varies contributes little to
the ranking whatever its weight.

```{r compare}
wlc_avail <- function(d, ncols, w, min_share = 0.8) {
  S <- as.matrix(d[, ncols]); W <- matrix(w, nrow(S), length(w), byrow = TRUE)
  W[is.na(S)] <- 0; S[is.na(S)] <- 0
  share <- rowSums(W) / sum(w)
  out <- rowSums(W * S) / rowSums(W)
  out[share < min_share] <- NA
  out
}
eff_weight <- function(d, ncols, w) {
  sds <- sapply(ncols, function(cl) sd(d[[cl]], na.rm = TRUE))
  setNames(round(100 * w * sds / sum(w * sds), 1), names(ncols))
}
compare_version <- function(new_gpp) {
  d <- dat; d[[norm_cols["gpp"]]] <- new_gpp
  s_new <- wlc_avail(d, norm_cols, weights)
  ok <- !is.na(s_ref) & !is.na(s_new)
  q_ref <- ntile(s_ref[ok], 5); q_new <- ntile(s_new[ok], 5)
  list(
    spearman       = round(cor(s_ref[ok], s_new[ok], method = "spearman"), 3),
    top_q_kept_pct = round(100 * mean(q_new[q_ref == 5] == 5), 1),
    eff_weight_gpp = eff_weight(d, norm_cols, weights)[["gpp"]],
    moved = tibble(row = which(ok), enters = q_new == 5 & q_ref != 5,
                   leaves = q_ref == 5 & q_new != 5)
  )
}

s_ref <- wlc_avail(dat, norm_cols, weights)
cat("Reference score vs saved priority_citizen, max |diff|:",
    signif(max(abs(s_ref - dat$priority_citizen), na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
stopifnot(max(abs(s_ref - dat$priority_citizen), na.rm = TRUE) < 1e-9)

cat("Citizen weight of green per person:", round(100 * weights[["gpp"]], 1), "%\n")
cat("Effective weight now:", eff_weight(dat, norm_cols, weights)[["gpp"]], "%\n")
knitr::kable(tibble(criterion = names(weights), citizen_pct = round(100 * weights, 1),
                    effective_pct = eff_weight(dat, norm_cols, weights)))

res <- lapply(nv, compare_version)
knitr::kable(t(sapply(res, function(r) unlist(r[c("spearman", "top_q_kept_pct", "eff_weight_gpp")]))))
```

## Where cells move (log version)

```{r moved-map, fig.width=7, fig.height=6}
mv <- res$log$moved
move <- rep("No change", nrow(dat))
move[mv$row[mv$enters]] <- "Enters top quintile"
move[mv$row[mv$leaves]] <- "Leaves top quintile"
cat("Enters:", sum(mv$enters), "| leaves:", sum(mv$leaves), "\n")

dat_sf %>%
  mutate(move = factor(move, c("Enters top quintile", "Leaves top quintile", "No change"))) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = move), colour = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Enters top quintile" = "#1B7837",
                               "Leaves top quintile" = "#B2182B",
                               "No change" = "grey90"), name = NULL) +
  labs(title = "Top quintile, log vs current normalisation of green per person") +
  theme_void()
```

# 6. Final checks

## Saved score vs rebuilt "current" version

```{r check-saved}
saved   <- dat$norm_green_exp
rebuilt <- nv$current

# a) How many cells differ, and by how much?
d_abs <- abs(saved - rebuilt)
summary(d_abs)
cat("Share of cells differing by more than 0.001:", round(mean(d_abs > 0.001, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
cat("Spearman saved vs rebuilt:",
    round(cor(saved, rebuilt, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"), 4), "\n")

# b) Which cap did the saved version use? Back-calculate it from the saved scores
lo_raw <- min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
implied_cap <- lo_raw + (x - lo_raw) / (1 - saved)
summary(implied_cap[saved > 0.01 & saved < 0.99])
quantile(x, 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)   # the cap the rebuild used
```

## Log version with bounds from populated cells

log10 of green per person; bounds are p2 and p98 of the log values over populated cells
(`pop_reallocated_nso > 0`); zeros get 1 (highest priority).

```{r check-final}
pop <- plot_dat$pop_reallocated_nso > 0   # same rows and order as dat (checked in section 1)
stopifnot(identical(as.character(plot_dat$gid), as.character(dat$gid)))

lx_pos <- ifelse(x > 0, log10(x), NA)
lo_pop <- quantile(lx_pos[pop], 0.02, na.rm = TRUE)
hi_pop <- quantile(lx_pos[pop], 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("Bounds (m² per person): p2 =", signif(10^lo_pop, 3), "| p98 =", signif(10^hi_pop, 3), "\n")

final <- case_when(is.na(x) ~ NA_real_,
                   x == 0   ~ 1,
                   TRUE     ~ 1 - (pmin(pmax(lx_pos, lo_pop), hi_pop) - lo_pop) / (hi_pop - lo_pop))
summary(final)

# Same table as before, for all cells and for populated cells
spread_tab <- function(v) c(above_0.9_pct = 100 * mean(v > 0.9, na.rm = TRUE),
                            iqr = IQR(v, na.rm = TRUE))
knitr::kable(rbind(script_log_all = spread_tab(nv$log),
                   final_all      = spread_tab(final),
                   final_pop      = spread_tab(final[pop])), digits = 3)

# How different is the final version from the script's log version?
cat("Spearman final vs script log:",
    round(cor(final, nv$log, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"), 4), "\n")

ggplot(tibble(v = final[pop]), aes(v)) + geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
  labs(x = "Normalised green per person (populated cells)", y = "Cells") + theme_minimal()
```

# 7. Checks before changing the score

Versions compared, all on eligible cells:

- **current**: the saved `norm_green_exp` (min max capped at p98 over all 10,657 cells);
- **log**: log10, bounds p2 and p98 of the log over eligible populated cells, zero = 1, missing stays missing;
- **log, unpopulated missing**: as log, but green per person is set to missing in unpopulated cells
  (`pop_reallocated_nso == 0`); those cells are scored on the other criteria under the 80% rule.

Unpopulated cells are split by their majority Urban Atlas 2021 class (`ua_code_2021`, as for eligibility):
**urban** = artificial surfaces (classes starting with 1), **rural** = all other classes.

```{r final-versions}
v_log <- final                                   # section 6
v_log_na <- if_else(pop, v_log, NA_real_)
versions <- list(current = dat$norm_green_exp, log = v_log, log_unpop_missing = v_log_na)

cell_type <- case_when(pop ~ "Populated",
                       substr(dat$ua_code_2021, 1, 1) == "1" ~ "Unpopulated urban",
                       TRUE ~ "Unpopulated rural")
table(cell_type, useNA = "ifany")
```

## 7.1 Zero green per person by population

```{r final-zeros}
tibble(type = if_else(pop, "Populated", "Unpopulated"), x = x) %>%
  group_by(type) %>%
  summarise(cells = n(), with_value = sum(!is.na(x)), zero = sum(x == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
            zero_pct = 100 * mean(x == 0, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 1)
```

## 7.2 Cells entering the top quintile

```{r final-entering}
score_of <- function(g) { d <- dat; d[[norm_cols["gpp"]]] <- g; wlc_avail(d, norm_cols, weights) }
scores <- lapply(versions, score_of)
stopifnot(max(abs(scores$current - dat$priority_citizen), na.rm = TRUE) < 1e-9)

quint <- function(s) { q <- rep(NA_integer_, length(s)); q[!is.na(s)] <- ntile(s[!is.na(s)], 5); q }
q_cur <- quint(scores$current)

moves <- function(name) {
  q_new <- quint(scores[[name]])
  tibble(row = seq_along(q_cur),
         move = case_when(q_new == 5 & q_cur != 5 ~ "Enters top quintile",
                          q_cur == 5 & q_new != 5 ~ "Leaves top quintile",
                          TRUE ~ "No change"))
}
mv_all <- lapply(c("log", "log_unpop_missing"), moves) %>% setNames(c("log", "log_unpop_missing"))

summ_tab <- bind_rows(lapply(names(mv_all), function(nm) {
  s0 <- scores$current; s1 <- scores[[nm]]; ok <- !is.na(s0) & !is.na(s1)
  q1 <- quint(s1)
  tibble(version = nm, scored = sum(!is.na(s1)),
         spearman = round(cor(s0[ok], s1[ok], method = "spearman"), 3),
         top_q_kept_pct = round(100 * mean(q1[q_cur == 5] == 5, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
         change_quintile_pct = round(100 * mean(q_cur[ok] != q1[ok]), 1))
}))
knitr::kable(summ_tab)

enter_tab <- bind_rows(lapply(names(mv_all), function(nm) {
  e <- mv_all[[nm]]$move == "Enters top quintile"
  tibble(version = nm, type = cell_type[e], zero = x[e] == 0) %>%
    group_by(version, type) %>%
    summarise(cells = n(), zero_gpp = sum(zero, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(cells_pct = round(100 * cells / sum(cells), 1))
}))
knitr::kable(enter_tab)
```

## 7.3 Effective weights

```{r final-eff-weights}
eff_tab <- tibble(criterion = names(weights), citizen_pct = round(100 * weights, 1))
for (nm in names(versions)) {
  d <- dat; d[[norm_cols["gpp"]]] <- versions[[nm]]
  eff_tab[[paste0("effective_", nm)]] <- eff_weight(d, norm_cols, weights)
}
knitr::kable(eff_tab)
```

## 7.4 Map of cells entering and leaving the top quintile

```{r final-map, fig.width=10, fig.height=5.5}
bind_rows(lapply(names(mv_all), function(nm)
  dat_sf %>% select(gid) %>% mutate(version = nm, move = mv_all[[nm]]$move))) %>%
  mutate(move = factor(move, c("Enters top quintile", "Leaves top quintile", "No change"))) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = move), colour = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Enters top quintile" = "#1B7837",
                               "Leaves top quintile" = "#B2182B",
                               "No change" = "grey90"), name = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~ version) +
  theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
